findings.prefill: All exact C2/C8 grouped row shapes are GPU-bound: wall minus HIP-event span stays below 0.04 ms. No memory-copy engine events fall inside any prefill tick. Synchronous hipMemcpy API spans wait on queued GPU work and are not copy overhead.
findings.mtp: At correctness-passing C7/C8, operation wall is 647.6/661.9 ms per average request cycle; telemetry stage sums explain 439.3/439.6 ms, leaving 208.3/222.4 ms outside named stages. Cycle windows contain no memory-copy engine events; copy kernels are under 0.7 ms/cycle. Q4/Q5/Q6 kernels dominate traced cycle work.
findings.kv: Attention-or-KV and state-commit kernels are reported separately in functional_kernel_ms_per_average_request_cycle; provider update and selected commit are also explicit telemetry stages.
findings.scheduler_server: The MTP wall-minus-stage residual is an upper bound spanning scheduler, server, inter-group waiting, and uninstrumented work; this artifact does not claim those causes are individually resolved. The independent prefill server-minus-direct diagnostic is reported by prompt and includes cross-run variance.
findings.c5: C5 attribution is retained only as failure localization because explicit MTP failed self-exactness. No C5 throughput result is claim-eligible.
